items.name: Manchester Cubing League - Third 2026
items.information:
Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**

Welcome to the first ever cubing league in Manchester! Top 16 finishers from each finals will be awarded points. More info [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ManchesterCLThird2026#67562-manchester-cubing-league).

**Only first 16 registered for MBLD can compete in MBLD.**
